# Repository Instructions

This repository investigates cosmological redshift mechanisms.

Guiding Rules:
- Do not assume finite universe age.
- Do not assume spatial boundaries.
- Do not assume expansion unless explicitly modeled.
- Treat Lambda-CDM as one candidate among several.
- Prefer mathematical and testable formulations.
- Ground claims in literature from ADS and arXiv.
- Use SymPy for symbolic derivations.
- Use observational data for scoring.
